reason: The policy states that for pending orders, 'each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.' The proposed action provides an empty new_item_ids array, which removes items entirely rather than modifying them to an available alternative item. This exceeds the scope of permitted modifications. The policy explicitly permits three types of pending-order changes: (1) modifying item options to a different variant of the same product, (2) modifying shipping address, or (3) modifying payment method. Partial removal of items while retaining others is not authorized. The only mechanism for item removal in the policy is full order cancellation. To proceed, the user would need to either cancel the entire order or modify specific items by changing their options within the same product type.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order.
